_comment: Minimum tests that must EXECUTE per project. The control for defect class DC-012: a crashed test host reports success with a smaller count, and nothing else notices. Raise these with `python tools/verify-test-run.py --update` when you add tests; never lower one to make a run pass. Keys with a suffix are HALVES of a project run on one OS; `splits` says which halves must account for which whole, and verify-test-run checks that sum on every invocation, on both operating systems. AiDe.Core.Tests.nonportable is [Trait("Platform","Windows")] only - kernel32, powershell.exe, the net10.0-windows daemon, and tests that assert Windows path semantics on purpose. There is no quarantine category: every test that merely failed on Linux was diagnosed and fixed (INV-0005).
_baselineBump: 2026-09-10, front-door HEAD-JOIN of F0 || F1 || FT plus seam FS1 (Rulings 36, 38). AiDe.App.Tests 399 -> 400 (F1's vendored-asset gate test); AiDe.Core.Tests 2014 -> 2037, portable 1862 -> 1885, nonportable unchanged at 152. MEASURED ON THE MERGED TREE, not apportioned and not carried over from the branch runs: --filter Platform!=Windows gave 1885 and --filter Platform=Windows gave 152, and 1885 + 152 = 2037, so the split invariant holds by observation. The rise is F0's 23 portable session-object cases; FT's 124 and F1's 1 were already baselined in their own nodes. verify-test-run.py --update was NEVER run to produce these numbers: --update skips the split invariant (:193) and returns 0 unconditionally (:269), so it cannot be the gate that sets the gate. CHECK mode is the standing gate; this bump is a separate recorded act, counter-signed by the runs quoted above. This RAISES every floor it touches; none was lowered.
